title: 有馬記念の後に・努力より尊いもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The legend… has been rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: OOOH YEAH! How ya like dem apples?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan is victorious! With all her effort, she manages to surpass both Oguri and McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hey, Trainer! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give her a great big hug. Her body is still hot from the race, and she's trembling like a child.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. I'm glad we could have a good race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go to the winner's circle. You're number one today, Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I really did it! YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan shouts with pride as she's announced the winner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you all, I was able to achieve my goal of winning both the Takarazuka and Arima Grand Prix races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I believe it's because of all the time I put toward this. The right effort will always be rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But there's something even more important than effort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More important than effort? This is the first time I've heard her say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's… having someone who watches over and recognizes all that effort, day in and day out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you all weren't watching… If you didn't vote for me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Then I wouldn't be any different from who I was before my debut, when I had zero confidence in myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I had a person who believed in me, who helped me as I kept on training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That person is the reason I'm standing here now. They believed in me, even when I didn't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks to them… I'm the person you see here today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I unconsciously clench my fists as I reflect on Mejiro Ryan's words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So please, everyone. Never give up on yourself. Even if you don't shine the brightest right now, you can still become a star.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heck, someone like me won two Grand Prix. If I can do it, so can you! As long as you try, your path to the future will open!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I ran today so that I could say this to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, for all your support! Thank yoouuu!

text_block_list.name: Gentleman with a Beret
text_block_list.text: Ryan! Oh, Ryan! I knew this day would come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fans, and this particular gentleman, are ecstatic. Even Mejiro McQueen is crying. As for Oguri Cap…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm… I guess I have some unfinished business left.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd done everything there was to do in the Twinkle Series, but now…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to race Mejiro Ryan one more—no, a few more times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The look in her eyes is that of someone completely enchanted. Mejiro Ryan is able to captivate even the most famous of racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with a very emotional finale, the Arima Kinen ends.
